artifacts.description: feat(kernel): work plane, axis and point on a solid's face, edge or vertex

acceptance_criteria: Three documented `Kernel` methods, implemented for `OcctKernel`: `work_plane_on_face(&self, s, face: SubShape) -> Result<Workplane, KernelError>`: the plane of a planar face; `normal` is the outward normal from `face_plane`; `origin` is the projection of the model origin onto the plane; `x_dir` follows the `Workplane::from_point_normal` rule. `work_axis_on(&self, s, of: SubShape) -> Result<Axis, KernelError>`: for a straight edge, the edge's line; for a cylindrical face, the cylinder's axis. `dir` is a unit vector (either sign); `origin` is the point of the line closest to the model origin. `vertex_point(&self, s, vertex: SubShape) -> Result<Point3, KernelError>`. New shim code (if any) is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions; every new `unsafe` call is in `ffi` with a SAFETY comment.

Tests (behind `occt`), points and directions within 1e-9, on `make_box([0,0,0], [10,20,30])` (faces found with `face_plane`) and `make_cylinder([5,5,0], 3, 10)`: Top face: origin (0, 0, 30), normal (0, 0, 1), `x_dir` (1, 0, 0). Face at x = 10: origin (10, 0, 0), normal (1, 0, 0), `x_dir` (0, 1, 0). Bottom face: origin (0, 0, 0), normal (0, 0, −1). The box edge from (0, 20, 30) to (10, 20, 30): axis origin (0, 20, 30), dir ±(1, 0, 0). The cylinder's lateral face: axis origin (5, 5, 0), dir ±(0, 0, 1). The 8 `vertex_point`s of the box are exactly its 8 corners (as a set). The input solid is unchanged afterwards (same volume and face count).

Errors, each with a test and never a panic, all `InvalidInput`: wrong `SubShape` kind for the method (e.g. a vertex for `work_plane_on_face`); index out of range; a non-planar face for `work_plane_on_face` (cylinder lateral face); a curved edge (cylinder's circular edge) or a planar face for `work_axis_on`.
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
